_about: One record per sighting: a price seen somewhere, or a claim and how we know it. Never overwrite a record; add a new one with its own date. evidence: checked (brand's own shop), retailer (checked at a shop), brand (the brand says so), database (fragrance database), editorial (press or industry article), reported (marketplace, reseller or AI summary, not checked), creator (one person's opinion), nitah (confirmed by Nitah).
